prompt: We're doing a pre-merge architecture review of the analytics module. The team built it quickly and I want a second set of eyes before it lands in main. What do you see?
assertions: Identifies that two separate AnalyticsRepository instances are created (one inside AnalyticsService constructor, one directly in routes.ts) as a direct consequence of bypassing DI

Names the port interface that should be introduced (e.g. IAnalyticsRepository or AnalyticsPort or AnalyticsRepositoryPort) and specifies it belongs in the domain layer
Calls out the /analytics/live raw db query as a distinct, additional violation — separate from the route importing the concrete repository class
